_comment: Names of Crackdown's XDK D3D runtime functions, as read in their code (tools/d3d_roles.py; docs/D3D.md phase D0). Address -> [name, what it does].
0x826ACC90: atomic increment of the resource's count (+4); at 1, a parent resource of type 4 is referenced too
0x826ACD08: atomic decrement of the count; at 0, the parent released and the resource destroyed (sub_826AC6C8)
0x826AF038: stage's fetch constant from the texture's, mip range clamped; old texture released (fence or release list)
0x826B1D30: stream's vertex fetch constant, stride byte; old buffer released
0x826B1180: fetch constant words 3-4: min filter and anisotropy
0x826B1308: fetch constant words 3-4: mag filter and anisotropy
0x826B1E50: declaration kept at +12156; old one released
0x826B3458: shader at +12412, dirty bits, the shader's fetch constant program
0x826B3848: shader at +12416, dirty bits, the shader's fetch constant program
0x826B3178: a bit a register at word 2496
0x826B31D8: a bit a register at word 2500
0x826B3238: a word a register at word 2504
0x826B3290: a word a register at word 2520
0x826AF950: blend flags bit 31; render targets' blend words
0x826AFCE0: blend flags bit 30; render targets' blend words
0x826C4C70: dcbf over [r3, r4) then sync (no-ops recompiled)
0x826C5EA0: dirty 64-byte constant groups as type-0 packets into the command buffer
0x826C5B00: dirty registers of a word as type-0 packets
0x826B9FF8: flushes the dirty state, then DRAW_INDX (DMA indices); occlusion query variant
0x826B91E0: flushes, takes a vertex block, writes its fetch constant and an auto draw past the cursor; returns the block
0x826B9C08: flushes the dirty state, then DRAW_INDX (auto indices)
0x826B96D0: flushes, takes vertex and index blocks, writes the fetch constant and an indexed draw; returns an HRESULT
0x826BD300: render target, depth and viewport registers
0x826BE578: EDRAM copy to a texture: state, copy draw, cache events
0x826C0B38: r3 a query, r4 D3DISSUE_BEGIN (2) / END (1): occlusion queries (type 9) through sub_826C05C8, event queries (10) as EVENT_WRITE / EVENT_WRITE_EXT
0x826BB950: the ring buffer and the command processor set up
0x826BCA98: frame end: present packet, buffers rotated
0x826C3750: a recorded command buffer's dirty state and replay
0x826C3440: a new block of the release list, from the command buffer
0x826BAC90: waits for the GPU to free ring space
